chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 2025, the Champions League final. Paris beat Inter five–nil, and Willian Pacho became the first Ecuadorian to win it! One reporter said he was world class at tracking back.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Watch how he does it. The ball goes over his head… so Pacho turns and sprints back!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He turns his hips, pumps his arms, and gets between the ball and the goal. Now he wins it!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: If an attacker gets past you, turn and sprint back goal side first. Then try to win the ball.
